items.title: [正面] Started the game attending my own funeral only to...
items.summary:
Started the game attending my own funeral only to kill the voice in my head and immediately ship out to the first level where I beat up street orphans. Pulled my vampire GF who eats our unborn children for power boosts. Abortion magic is really effective and apparently a pretty good source of nutrition because I've already raised the first daughter she DIDN'T consume into a poorly-adjusted 11 year old, which by Victorian standards makes her old enough to qualify for full-time work in my sweatshop of horrors. 

So anyway yeah I recommend.

items.title:
[正面] one of most generous F2P  gacha Game

if you're in...
items.summary:
one of most generous F2P  gacha Game

if you're into a game with story who ask about forgetting and remembering the trace of one's journey and lives, youre in for a treat

be know that this game is develiped by small company, and some chapter MAY or may not is not human translated, in that case you need to wait, you could help directly by going to their discord 

now, 2 point i want to make that make me like this game

gacha, very generous, you get gacha currency almost like water here, however, when pulling i encourage and strongly reccomend you to research the character whether they are dupe reliant or not, some are, some not

gameplay, the gameplay is a deck building roguelite, however the deck is resetted every stage so its bit simple, but dont take this as the game being easy, play it enough to reach mid-game and you notice you need some strategy/know how the team work to beat, theres no point to play this game if you are whaler but often just play on auto, youre gonna get punished so hard, especially in endgame content

even whaler need some sort of thinking here

i would say this game is 10/10 from me, biased, sure, but it's one of the game i genuinely enjoy despite the flaw you might finds in the game

items.title: [正面] 其实我真的很喜欢忘却前夜，无论是风格，美工，剧情，我都认为它无可挑剔，肯定大家或多或少听过它的策划做...
items.summary: 其实我真的很喜欢忘却前夜，无论是风格，美工，剧情，我都认为它无可挑剔，肯定大家或多或少听过它的策划做的那些事，但是它是个好游戏，角色塑造其实也很成功，每个角色给我的印象都很深，如想入坑，我还很推荐的，相比起其他的二游，忘却前夜真的很用心，很多人说它的剧情不太好，但我认为，如果你真的静下来，用心去感受，还是会发现不一样的天地，不抱着我玩这游戏是未来组配合打核爆来的话，其实你也能玩的比较舒服，而且遇到剧情里的艰难战斗时，也会更有代入感，把它当作jrpg来玩就好
